name: HubSpot Portal Configuration Snapshot → Git Backup (Safe-by-Default)

parameters.content:
## HubSpot Portal Configuration Snapshot → Git

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set this workflow runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** against a synthetic fixture (portal 99000001), makes **zero network calls**, and never commits.

To go live you must explicitly set:
`SANDBOX_MODE=false` · `DRY_RUN=false` · `GIT_COMMITS_ENABLED=true`
plus `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID`, `GITHUB_PAT`, `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`.

HubSpot calls are **GET only**. Secrets are read from `$env` inside HTTP header expressions and never copied into item data.

Requires `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`. See README.md.

nodes.name: Daily Snapshot Schedule
nodes.notes: Daily at 02:15 in the n8n instance time zone (GENERIC_TIMEZONE). The workflow ships inactive.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Reads env vars, resolves fail-safe flags. Throws in live mode if HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN / HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID are missing.

nodes.name: Sandbox Mode?
nodes.notes: true → synthetic fixture (offline). false → live read-only HubSpot export.

const { config } = $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json;
const s = config.scope;
const pick = (obj, keys) => Object.fromEntries(keys.filter((k) => obj && obj[k]).map((k) => [k, obj[k]]));

const raw = {
  portalId: String(FIXTURE.portalId),
  accountInfo: FIXTURE.accountInfo || null,
  customObjectSchemas: s.customObjects ? FIXTURE.customObjectSchemas || [] : null,
  properties: s.properties ? pick(FIXTURE.properties, s.objectTypes) : null,
  propertyGroups: s.propertyGroups ? pick(FIXTURE.propertyGroups, s.objectTypes) : null,
  pipelines: s.pipelines ? pick(FIXTURE.pipelines, s.pipelineObjectTypes) : null,
  workflows: s.workflows ? FIXTURE.workflows || [] : null,
  workflowsApi: 'v4',
};

const warnings = [];
for (const t of s.objectTypes) {
  if (s.properties && !(FIXTURE.properties || {})[t]) warnings.push(`Fixture has no properties for object type "${t}"`);
}

return [{ json: { source: 'synthetic-fixture', raw, endpointErrors: [], warnings } }];

nodes.name: HubSpot Metadata Export (v3 API)
nodes.notes: GET only. Batched to stay well under HubSpot private-app rate limits. Per-endpoint errors are recorded, not fatal.

nodes.name: Collect & Verify API Responses
nodes.notes: Pairs responses to requests and enforces the portal guard.

nodes.name: HubSpot Workflows Export
nodes.notes: v4 /automation/v4/flows (all object types, paginated) by default; v3 /automation/v3/workflows (contact-based only) via HUBSPOT_WORKFLOWS_API=v3.

nodes.name: Normalization & Checksum Auditor
nodes.notes: Deterministic sorted JSON + SHA-256 per file, per record and per bundle. Integrity self-check.

nodes.name: Remote Diff Read Enabled?
nodes.notes: Live mode with GITHUB_PAT + GITHUB_REPOSITORY: read previous manifest (GET only).

nodes.name: Fetch Previous Manifest (Git)
nodes.notes: A 404 on the first run is expected and handled.

nodes.name: Versioned Diff Builder
nodes.notes: File- and record-level diff, manifest lineage, commit message, commit gate.

nodes.name: Commit Gate Open?
nodes.notes: Open only if: live, DRY_RUN=false, GIT_COMMITS_ENABLED=true, creds present, branch not protected, health OK, changes detected.

nodes.name: Git: Get Branch Ref
nodes.notes: The target branch must already exist (see README).

nodes.name: Git: Update Branch Ref
nodes.notes: force:false — a concurrent push makes this fail safely instead of overwriting history.

nodes.name: Dry-Run Preview
nodes.notes: Shows the exact commit that would be made and every reason it was blocked.
